notes: Dropped Afuega'l Pitu PDO from fresh white cheese: it is a ripened Asturian cheese, hand to the Spanish shelf. Kept Cebreiro, Camerano and Tomme fraîche de l'Aubrac as plain models (fresh forms exist) since no page was retrieved to make them archetypes. Brousse du Rove kept once (in Ricotta & whey cheese), duplicate removed from fresh white cheese. Katiki Domokou, Anevato, Casatella, Xygalo and Pichtogalo stay as models: no retrievable source page (anycheese 403). Montrachet left out: retrieved snippets say it is aged at least four weeks, not fresh. Soignon's bûches are ripened logs (belong with soft white-rind / lactic goat), so only its fresh lines are listed. Duplicate Gowardhan entry merged under Parag Milk Foods. Vermont Creamery honey goat cheese moved to Fresh goat's cheese. Ricotta salata, infornata, affumicata and forte are types, not archetypes. Skyr and labneh belong to the yoghurt shelf.
